input.quote: 11.1.1.4 Trial Data Package. SFJ shall be the sole and exclusive owner of the Trial Data Package including the Research Results included therein.
input.rationale: Article 11 is otherwise favourable: PB is the sole owner of, and SFJ assigns, all Trial Inventions (p0659), and each Party retains its pre-Effective Date IP (p0650), so the fallback deliverable elements are exceeded by outright PB ownership and there is no joint ownership anywhere. The failure is Section 11.1.1.4: SFJ is made sole and exclusive owner of the Trial Data Package, i.e. all clinical trial data and Research Results generated under our Development Program, until PB buys it back (Article 6 pricing at p0489; termination buy-backs at p0750 et seq.). Vesting our own data in the counterparty is walk-away territory and gives SFJ rights far beyond processing to perform the services. The redline flips ownership to PB, limits SFJ to processing the data solely to perform its obligations, and conforms the retained sale wording so the Exhibit K agreement confirms PB's ownership; the payment consideration and the 14.3.1 backstop assignment (p0783) are left intact.

proposal.summary: PB owns the Trial Data Package and Research Results from the outset; SFJ may process them only to perform its obligations, with the Exhibit K mechanic conformed.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot leave our own clinical trial data vested in SFJ, so we have flipped Section 11.1.1.4 to make PB the owner of the Trial Data Package and Research Results and limited SFJ to processing them solely to perform its obligations. The payment consideration is untouched; the Exhibit K purchase agreement now confirms PB's ownership rather than re-selling it.
